score_basis: 8 graded events (7 in-window + 1 outside_window per Rule 7); recency weights 8..1; Q1 FY27 pending and excluded. Grades most-recent-first: 2,2,1,1,1,1,0,0. (48/36) x 5 = 6.67.
note: Standard mode: 8 consecutive quarterly calls Q2 FY25-Q1 FY27 opened from cosmofirst.com/investors/investors-presentation (plus Q1 FY25 for Rule 7). Basis consolidated throughout. Most Q&A answers are labelled 'Management' in the transcripts; speaker recorded as such. Page numbers are from the transcript page markers and may be off by one. Pattern: commissioning dates and group revenue guidance are met (CPP Mar-25, BOPP Jun-25, sunshield May-25; FY26 revenue Rs3,639 Cr inside both Rs3,500-4,000 Cr and Rs3,500-3,800 Cr ranges). Balance-sheet and new-business profitability promises slip repeatedly: debt was to peak in FY25 at ~2x EBITDA, instead peaked Sep-25 at Rs1,230 Cr / 2.97x and FY26 closed above FY25; FY25 capex guided Rs300-350 Cr, delivered Rs500+ Cr; Plastech EBITDA promised end FY25 -> Q4 FY25 -> FY26 -> Q3 FY26, breakeven Dec-25, positive Q1 FY27; FY26 Plastech revenue ~Rs92-100 Cr vs Rs120-150 Cr guided; 80% specialty exit-rate target for FY26 silently re-based. Ramp-up of the new BOPP line slipped (2-3 months from Aug-25 -> Q4 FY26 -> March 2026 -> next two quarters from Aug-26) with reasons given. Zigly demerger date has moved five times. Recent calls (Q3-Q4 FY26) score better: near-term guidance met. 'Major issue' test: no item would be a Severe forensic flag; no grade-0 override from that test. Not retrieved: FY26 actual capex, FY26 cost-saving achieved, FY26 specialty revenue, commissioning of the two further lines (Q4 FY26 / Q1 FY27), FY25 US sales in USD, FY25 dividend payment. Rule 6: no Reg 30 boilerplate captured. Rule 7: debt-reduction, Plastech-EBITDA and capex promises traced to Q1 FY25 call (2024-08-09); earlier calls not opened.
